_comment: Every prompt the harness sends, in one place. Code never contains prompt wording: it names a template here and fills the {placeholders}. Editing a string in this file changes the experiment; keep it in sync with the paper's Sec 4.3.
tree_node_global_list: The full set of possible final classes is: {class_names_str}. {question} Choose one of these answers: {answers}.
tree_system_instruction: You will be asked a series of questions to classify this image. Answer each question based on the image and descriptions provided.
cot: Classify the object in this image. Think step by step: first describe the visually distinguishing features you observe, then reason about which of the following classes best matches those features: {class_names_str}. End your response with a new line reading exactly: Final answer: <class ID number>
clip_superclass_fallback: An image where the answer to the question '{question}' is '{answer}'.
label_conditioned_system: You will be asked a series of questions to classify an object belonging to the class: '{class_name}'. Answer each question based on this class's typical characteristics.
